verdict.rationale: Ollama runs open models that users can chat with (CLI, desktop app, API). However, no evidence shows a built-in feature that analyzes the user's own data inside the product and surfaces insights or suggestions. Generic model chat and API access are building blocks a user could apply to their data, not a documented in-product insights capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
